note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: lessons
datasets.select: SELECT id,course_id,status,learned_sections,latest_section_id,latest_learn_time,create_time,expire_time FROM learning_lesson WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_lesson WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: progress
datasets.select: SELECT id,lesson_id,section_id,moment,finished,create_time,finish_time FROM learning_record WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_record WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: notes
datasets.select: SELECT id,course_id,section_id,moment,content,deleted,created_at,updated_at FROM course_note WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_note WHERE user_id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_note WHERE user_id=? AND updated_at<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE course_note SET content='[已清理]',deleted=1 WHERE user_id=? AND updated_at<?

datasets.name: questions
datasets.select: SELECT id,title,description,course_id,section_id,status,create_time FROM interaction_question WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction_question WHERE user_id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction_question WHERE user_id=? AND update_time<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE interaction_question SET title='已注销学员的提问',description='[已清理]',hidden=1,anonymity=1 WHERE user_id=? AND update_time<?

datasets.name: replies
datasets.select: SELECT id,question_id,content,create_time FROM interaction_reply WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction_reply WHERE user_id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction_reply WHERE user_id=? AND update_time<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE interaction_reply SET content='[已清理]',hidden=1,anonymity=1 WHERE user_id=? AND update_time<?

datasets.name: favorites
datasets.select: SELECT course_id,created_at FROM course_favorite WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY course_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_favorite WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: points
datasets.select: SELECT id,type,points,create_time FROM points_record WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM points_record WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: signs
datasets.select: SELECT sign_day,sign_days,reward_points FROM sign_record WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY sign_day
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sign_record WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: entitlements
datasets.select: SELECT order_detail_id,course_id,active,expires_at,created_at FROM learning_entitlement WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY order_detail_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_entitlement WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: milestones
datasets.select: SELECT course_id,section_id,kind,completed_at FROM learning_milestone WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY course_id,section_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_milestone WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: achievements
datasets.select: SELECT code,season_month,name,awarded_at FROM learning_achievement WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY code,season_month
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_achievement WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: ranks
datasets.select: SELECT board_month,rank_no,points,display_name FROM learning_season_rank WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY board_month
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_season_rank WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: rewards
datasets.select: SELECT request_id,board_month,rank_no,coupon_id,status,user_coupon_id,created_at FROM learning_reward_request WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY request_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_reward_request WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
